name: Tarek
notes: Respects him deeply. Feels he carries old fears he never talks about.

name: Luma
notes: Closest relationship. Learns much of her understanding of people from her.

name: Ikan
notes: Loves him. Often believes he searches in the wrong places.

name: Nara
notes: Finds her fascinating. Frequently asks about old traditions.

name: Ren
notes: One of the few villagers who takes her observations seriously.

name: Elira
notes: Secretly visits her occasionally. Believes she has been unfairly isolated.
